mapper.insert: /* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.insertQna */ INSERT INTO OP_QNA ( QNA_ID, QNA_GROUP, QNA_TYPE, SUBJECT, QUESTION, USER_ID, USER_NAME, EMAIL, ITEM_ID, SELLER_ID, ORDER_CODE, ANSWER_COUNT, SECRET_FLAG, DISPLAY_FLAG, CREATED_DATE, DATA_STATUS_CODE, QNA_IMAGE, USE_YN, HITS ) VALUES ( #{qnaId}, #{qnaGroup}, #{qnaType}, #{subject}, #{question}, #{userId}, CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{userName},''), CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{email},''), #{itemId}, #{sellerId}, #{orderCode}, #{answerCount}, #{secretFlag}, 'Y', , '0', #{qnaImage}, 'Y', 0 )
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getQnaAnswerByQnaId */ SELECT BB.* ,crypto_dec('normal', BB.USER_NM, '', 0) as USER_NM FROM ( SELECT B.* , IFNULL( (SELECT M.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME FROM OP_MANAGER M WHERE M.USER_ID = B.USER_ID), ( SELECT S.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME FROM OP_SELLER_USER S WHERE S.USER_ID = B.USER_ID) ) USER_NM, (SELECT crypto_dec('normal', U.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) LOGIN_ID FROM OP_USER U WHERE B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE = '9') AS LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER B WHERE B.QNA_ID = #{value} AND B.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 ORDER BY ANSWER_DATE LIMIT 1 ) BB

/* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getQnaByQnaId */ SELECT Q.QNA_ID, Q.QNA_GROUP, Q.QNA_TYPE, Q.SUBJECT, Q.QUESTION, Q.USER_ID, Q.SELLER_ID, Q.ITEM_ID, Q.ORDER_CODE, Q.ANSWER_COUNT, Q.SECRET_FLAG, Q.DISPLAY_FLAG, Q.CREATED_DATE, Q.DATA_STATUS_CODE, Q.QNA_IMAGE, Q.USE_YN, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', Q.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', Q.EMAIL, '', 0) AS EMAIL,
CRYPTO_DEC('normal', Q.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID, QA.*, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_USER_CODE, (SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM OP_ROLE WHERE AUTHORITY = (SELECT AUTHORITY FROM OP_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = QA.USER_ID AND AUTHORITY LIKE CONCAT('ROLE_ADMIN', '%') LIMIT 1)) AS ROLE_NM, crypto_dec('normal', (select login_id from op_manager where user_id = QA.user_id), '', 0) as ANSWER_LOGIN_ID FROM ( SELECT
Q.QNA_ID, Q.QNA_GROUP, Q.QNA_TYPE, Q.SUBJECT, Q.QUESTION, Q.USER_ID, Q.SELLER_ID, Q.ITEM_ID, Q.ORDER_CODE, Q.ANSWER_COUNT, Q.SECRET_FLAG, Q.DISPLAY_FLAG, Q.CREATED_DATE, Q.DATA_STATUS_CODE, Q.QNA_IMAGE, Q.USE_YN, Q.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME, Q.EMAIL AS EMAIL,
U.LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA Q LEFT JOIN OP_USER U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE = '9' WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId} ) Q LEFT JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER QA ON Q.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM I ON Q.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID

/* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getQnaByQnaAnswerId */ SELECT Q.QNA_ID, Q.QNA_GROUP, Q.QNA_TYPE, Q.SUBJECT, Q.QUESTION, Q.USER_ID, Q.SELLER_ID, Q.ITEM_ID, Q.ORDER_CODE, Q.ANSWER_COUNT, Q.SECRET_FLAG, Q.DISPLAY_FLAG, Q.CREATED_DATE, Q.DATA_STATUS_CODE, Q.QNA_IMAGE, Q.USE_YN, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', U.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', Q.EMAIL, '', 0) AS EMAIL,
CRYPTO_DEC('normal', U.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID, QA.*, I.ITEM_NAME, I.ITEM_USER_CODE, (SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM OP_ROLE WHERE AUTHORITY = (SELECT AUTHORITY FROM OP_USER_ROLE WHERE USER_ID = QA.USER_ID AND AUTHORITY LIKE CONCAT('ROLE_ADMIN', '%') LIMIT 1)) AS ROLE_NM, crypto_dec('normal', (select login_id from op_manager where user_id = QA.user_id), '', 0) as ANSWER_LOGIN_ID FROM ( SELECT QNA_ANSWER_ID , QNA_ID , ANSWER , USER_ID , TITLE , SEND_SMS_FLAG , SEND_MAIL_FLAG , ANSWER_DATE , DATA_STATUS_CODE , HITS , SECRET_FLAG FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA WHERE QNA_ANSWER_ID = #{qnaAnswerId} ) QA LEFT JOIN OP_QNA Q ON Q.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID LEFT JOIN OP_USER U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE = '9' LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM I ON Q.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID

/* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getQnaAnswerByQnaAnswerId */ SELECT BB.* ,crypto_dec('normal', BB.USER_NM, '', 0) as USER_NM FROM ( SELECT B.* , IFNULL( (SELECT M.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME FROM OP_MANAGER M WHERE M.USER_ID = B.USER_ID), ( SELECT S.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME FROM OP_SELLER_USER S WHERE S.USER_ID = B.USER_ID) ) USER_NM, (SELECT crypto_dec('normal', U.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) LOGIN_ID FROM OP_USER U WHERE B.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE = '9') AS LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER B WHERE B.QNA_ANSWER_ID = #{answerId} AND B.QNA_ID = #{qnaId} ) BB

/** qna-mapper.getFrontQnaOpenListCount (QNA 카운트) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT QNA_ID, 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE FROM OP_QNA Q WHERE QNA_TYPE = 2 AND DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
UNION ALL SELECT QA.QNA_ID, 'A' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA INNER JOIN OP_QNA Q ON Q.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID AND Q.QNA_TYPE = 2 AND Q.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND Q.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND Q.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
WHERE QA.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
) A LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER B ON A.QNA_ID = B.QNA_ID WHERE 1=1
AND A.CREATED_DATE >= CONCAT(#{searchStartDate}, '000000')
AND A.CREATED_DATE <= CONCAT(#{searchEndDate}, '235959')

/** qna-mapper.getFrontQnaOpenListCount (QNA 카운트) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT QNA_ID, NULL AS QNA_ANSWER_ID, CREATED_DATE, USER_ID, USER_NAME, 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, HITS, SECRET_FLAG, QUESTION AS CONTENT, QNA_GROUP, (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE C WHERE C.ID = Q.QNA_GROUP AND C.CODE_TYPE = 'QNA_GROUPS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y') AS QNA_GROUP_NM, (SELECT U.LOGIN_ID FROM OP_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = Q.USER_ID) AS LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA Q WHERE QNA_TYPE = 2 AND DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
UNION ALL SELECT QA.QNA_ID, QA.QNA_ANSWER_ID, QA.ANSWER_DATE, QA.USER_ID, IFNULL(M.USER_NAME, U.USER_NAME) AS USER_NAME, 'A' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, QA.TITLE, QA.HITS, QA.SECRET_FLAG, QA.ANSWER AS CONTENT, '' AS QNA_GROUP, '' AS QNA_GROUP_NM, M.LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA INNER JOIN OP_QNA Q ON Q.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID AND Q.QNA_TYPE = 2 AND Q.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND Q.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND Q.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON M.USER_ID = QA.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = QA.USER_ID WHERE QA.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
) A LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER B ON A.QNA_ID = B.QNA_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.QNA_DETAIL_TYPE = 'Q'
AND A.CREATED_DATE >= CONCAT(#{searchStartDate}, '000000')
AND A.CREATED_DATE <= CONCAT(#{searchEndDate}, '235959')

/* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getFrontQnaOpenList */ SELECT T_A.QNA_ID, T_A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, T_A.CREATED_DATE, T_A.QNA_USER_ID, T_A.USER_ID, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME, T_A.QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, T_A.SUBJECT, T_A.HITS, T_A.QNA_SECRET_FLAG, T_A.SECRET_FLAG, T_A.CONTENT, T_A.QNA_GROUP, T_A.QNA_GROUP_NM, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', T_A.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA WHERE T_A.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID) AS ANSWER_CNT, IFNULL(T_A.USER_ID, 0) AS ANSWER_USER_ID, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE USER_ID = T_A.USER_ID2), '', 0) AS ANSWER_LOGIN_ID, CRYPTO_DEC('normal', (SELECT USER_NAME FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE USER_ID = T_A.USER_ID2), '', 0) AS ANSWER_USER_NAME, T_A.ANSWER_DATE FROM (
SELECT A.QNA_ID, A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, A.CREATED_DATE, A.QNA_USER_ID, A.USER_ID,
A.USER_NAME, A.QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, A.SUBJECT, A.HITS, A.QNA_SECRET_FLAG, A.SECRET_FLAG, A.CONTENT, A.QNA_GROUP, A.QNA_GROUP_NM,
A.LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA WHERE A.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID) AS ANSWER_CNT, IFNULL(B.USER_ID, 0) AS USER_ID2,
B.ANSWER_DATE FROM ( SELECT QNA_ID, 0 AS QNA_ANSWER_ID, CREATED_DATE, USER_ID AS QNA_USER_ID, USER_ID, USER_NAME, 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, HITS, SECRET_FLAG AS QNA_SECRET_FLAG, SECRET_FLAG, QUESTION AS CONTENT, QNA_GROUP, (SELECT LABEL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE C WHERE C.ID = Q.QNA_GROUP AND C.CODE_TYPE = 'QNA_GROUPS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y') AS QNA_GROUP_NM, (SELECT U.LOGIN_ID FROM OP_USER U WHERE U.USER_ID = Q.USER_ID) AS LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA Q WHERE QNA_TYPE = 2 AND DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
UNION ALL
SELECT QA.QNA_ID, QA.QNA_ANSWER_ID, QA.ANSWER_DATE, Q.USER_ID AS QNA_USER_ID, QA.USER_ID, IFNULL(M.USER_NAME, U.USER_NAME) AS USER_NAME, 'A' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, QA.TITLE, QA.HITS, Q.SECRET_FLAG AS QNA_SECRET_FLAG, QA.SECRET_FLAG, QA.ANSWER AS CONTENT, '' AS QNA_GROUP, '' AS QNA_GROUP_NM,
M.LOGIN_ID AS LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA INNER JOIN OP_QNA Q ON Q.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID AND Q.QNA_TYPE = 2 AND Q.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND Q.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND Q.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON M.USER_ID = QA.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = QA.USER_ID WHERE QA.DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
) A LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER B ON A.QNA_ID = B.QNA_ID WHERE 1=1
AND A.CREATED_DATE >= CONCAT(#{searchStartDate}, '000000')
AND A.CREATED_DATE <= CONCAT(#{searchEndDate}, '235959')
ORDER BY
A.QNA_ID (SELECT IFNULL(HITS, 0) FROM OP_QNA WHERE QNA_ID = A.QNA_ID) A.QNA_ID
ASC DESC
, IFNULL(A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, 0) , IFNULL(A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, 0)
A.QNA_ID DESC, A.QNA_ANSWER_ID ASC
) T_A

/* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getFrontQnaOpenManagerListCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT Q.QNA_ID, NULL AS QNA_ANSWER_ID, Q.CREATED_DATE, Q.USER_ID, Q.USER_NAME, 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, Q.SUBJECT, Q.HITS, Q.SECRET_FLAG, Q.QUESTION AS CONTENT, Q.QNA_GROUP, C.LABEL AS QNA_GROUP_NM, U.LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA Q LEFT JOIN OP_USER U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE = '9' LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.ID = Q.QNA_GROUP AND C.CODE_TYPE = 'QNA_GROUPS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE QNA_TYPE = 2 AND DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND Q.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
AND C.LABEL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.QUESTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND U.LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT ('%', crypto_enc('normal', #{query}, '') , '%')

) A LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER B ON A.QNA_ID = B.QNA_ID WHERE 1=1

SELECT A.QNA_ID, A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, A.CREATED_DATE, A.USER_ID, crypto_dec('normal', A.USER_NAME, '', 0) as USER_NAME, A.QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, A.SUBJECT, A.HITS, A.SECRET_FLAG, A.CONTENT, A.QNA_GROUP, A.QNA_GROUP_NM, crypto_dec('normal', A.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER QA WHERE A.QNA_ID = QA.QNA_ID) AS ANSWER_CNT, IFNULL(B.USER_ID, 0) as ANSWER_USER_ID, crypto_dec('normal', (SELECT LOGIN_ID FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE USER_ID = B.USER_ID), '', 0) AS ANSWER_LOGIN_ID, crypto_dec('normal', (SELECT USER_NAME FROM OP_MANAGER WHERE USER_ID = B.USER_ID), '', 0) AS ANSWER_USER_NAME, B.ANSWER_DATE FROM ( SELECT Q.QNA_ID, 0 AS QNA_ANSWER_ID, Q.CREATED_DATE, Q.USER_ID, Q.USER_NAME, 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, Q.SUBJECT, Q.HITS, Q.SECRET_FLAG, Q.QUESTION AS CONTENT, Q.QNA_GROUP, C.LABEL AS QNA_GROUP_NM, U.LOGIN_ID FROM OP_QNA Q LEFT JOIN OP_USER U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND U.STATUS_CODE = '9' LEFT JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C ON C.ID = Q.QNA_GROUP AND C.CODE_TYPE = 'QNA_GROUPS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE QNA_TYPE = 2 AND DATA_STATUS_CODE = 0 AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND Q.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT > 0
AND Q.ANSWER_COUNT = 0
AND C.LABEL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND Q.SUBJECT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')
AND Q.QUESTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query} , '%')
AND U.LOGIN_ID LIKE CONCAT ('%', crypto_enc('normal', #{query}, '') , '%')
AND Q.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{query},''), '%')
) A LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER B ON A.QNA_ID = B.QNA_ID WHERE 1=1
AND A.CREATED_DATE >= CONCAT(#{searchStartDate}, '000000')
AND A.CREATED_DATE <= CONCAT(#{searchEndDate}, '235959')

A.QNA_ID (SELECT IFNULL(HITS, 0) FROM OP_QNA WHERE QNA_ID = A.QNA_ID) A.QNA_ID
ASC DESC
, IFNULL(A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, 0) , IFNULL(A.QNA_ANSWER_ID, 0)
A.QNA_ID DESC, A.QNA_ANSWER_ID ASC

/** qna-mapper.getFrontQnaFileList (QNA 파일 목록 조회) */ SELECT 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, crypto_enc('normal', F.QNA_FILE_ID,'') AS QNA_FILE_ID, F.QNA_ID, F.FILE_NAME, F.FILE_TY, F.ORDERING, F.CREATED_DATE, F.ORG_FILE_NAME, (SELECT Q.QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA Q WHERE Q.QNA_ID = F.QNA_ID LIMIT 1) AS QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA_FILE F WHERE F.QNA_ID = #{qnaId} ORDER BY F.ORDERING

/** qna-mapper.getFrontQnaAnswerFileList (QNA 답변 파일 목록 조회) */ SELECT 'A' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, crypto_enc('normal', F.QNA_ANSWER_FILE_ID,'') AS QNA_FILE_ID, F.QNA_ANSWER_ID AS QNA_ID, F.FILE_NAME, F.FILE_TY, F.ORDERING, F.CREATED_DATE, F.ORG_FILE_NAME, ( SELECT QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA Q INNER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER A ON Q.QNA_ID = A.QNA_ID WHERE A.QNA_ANSWER_ID = F.QNA_ANSWER_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER_FILE F WHERE F.QNA_ANSWER_ID = #{qnaAnswerId} ORDER BY F.ORDERING

/** qna-mapper.getFrontQnaFileDetail (QNA 파일 상세 조회) */ SELECT 'Q' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, F.QNA_FILE_ID, F.QNA_ID, F.FILE_NAME, F.FILE_TY, F.ORDERING, F.CREATED_DATE, F.ORG_FILE_NAME, (SELECT Q.QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA Q WHERE Q.QNA_ID = F.QNA_ID LIMIT 1) AS QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA_FILE F WHERE crypto_enc('normal', F.QNA_FILE_ID,'') = #{qnaFileId}

/** qna-mapper.getFrontQnaAnswerFileDetail (QNA 답변 파일 상세 조회) */ SELECT 'A' AS QNA_DETAIL_TYPE, F.QNA_ANSWER_FILE_ID AS QNA_FILE_ID, F.QNA_ANSWER_ID AS QNA_ID, F.FILE_NAME, F.FILE_TY, F.ORDERING, F.CREATED_DATE, F.ORG_FILE_NAME, ( SELECT QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA Q INNER JOIN OP_QNA_ANSWER A ON Q.QNA_ID = A.QNA_ID WHERE A.QNA_ANSWER_ID = F.QNA_ANSWER_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS QNA_TYPE FROM OP_QNA_ANSWER_FILE F WHERE crypto_enc('normal', F.QNA_ANSWER_FILE_ID,'') = #{qnaFileId}
mapper.insert: /** qna-mapper.insertQnaFile (QNA 파일 등록) */ INSERT INTO OP_QNA_FILE ( QNA_FILE_ID, QNA_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_TY, ORDERING, CREATED_DATE, ORG_FILE_NAME ) VALUES ( #{qnaFileId}, #{qnaId}, #{fileName}, #{fileTy}, (SELECT IFNULL(MAX(ORDERING), 0)+1 FROM OP_QNA_FILE WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId}), , #{orgFileName} )
mapper.update: /** qna-mapper.updateFrontQnaOpen (QNA 수정) */ UPDATE OP_QNA SET QNA_GROUP = #{qnaGroup}, SUBJECT = #{subject}, QUESTION = #{question}, USER_NAME = CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{userName},''), EMAIL = CRYPTO_ENC('normal', #{email},''), SECRET_FLAG = #{secretFlag} WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId}

/** qna-mapper.updateQnaFileOrdering (QNA 파일 재정렬) */ UPDATE OP_QNA_FILE A INNER JOIN ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, F.QNA_FILE_ID, F.ORDERING FROM OP_QNA_FILE F WHERE F.QNA_ID = #{qnaId} ORDER BY F.QNA_FILE_ID ) B ON A.QNA_FILE_ID = B.QNA_FILE_ID SET A.ORDERING = B.RNUM
/* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.updateQnaAnswerCountZero */ UPDATE OP_QNA SET ANSWER_COUNT = 0 WHERE QNA_ID = (select qna_id from op_qna_answer where qna_answer_id = #{qnaAnswerId})
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.qna.QnaMapper.getQnaUserInfo */ SELECT CRYPTO_DEC('normal', A.USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME ,A.RECEIVE_SMS ,A.MBER_CI ,A.USER_ID ,REPLACE (CRYPTO_DEC('normal',A.PHONE_NUMBER, '', 0),'-','') AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT B.USER_NAME ,C.RECEIVE_SMS ,B.MBER_CI ,B.USER_ID ,C.PHONE_NUMBER FROM OP_QNA A INNER JOIN OP_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL C ON B.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId} ) A
